examples.title: Rotate, Resize and Zoom PDF Pages
examples.description: Demonstrates how to chain multiple page modifications—rotation, size change, and a simulated zoom—on each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and then save the result.

examples.title: Change PDF Page Size and Undo to Original Dimensions
examples.description: Demonstrates how to record original page dimensions, apply a custom size to all pages, save the modified PDF, and then revert the pages back to their original sizes to test undo functionality.

examples.title: Resize PDF Pages to A3 Size
examples.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, set each page's dimensions to A3, and save the modified document.

examples.title: Rotate and Zoom PDF Pages for Presentation Transitions

examples.title: Convert PDF Pages to Landscape Orientation
examples.description: Demonstrates how to change each page of a PDF from portrait to A4 landscape by adjusting the PageInfo width, height, and orientation using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Convert Portrait PDF Pages to Landscape and Verify Dimensions
examples.description: Loads a PDF, swaps width and height of portrait pages, rotates their content to landscape, saves the result, and then prints the final page dimensions for verification.

examples.title: Set Uniform Margins for PDF Content Resize
examples.description: This example shows how to create a ContentsResizeParameters object with a 5‑point margin on all sides, which can be passed to PdfFileEditor.ResizeContents to adjust PDF page content.

examples.title: Create PDF Slideshow with Page Transitions
examples.description: Demonstrates how to set page transition effects and display durations for all pages using PdfPageEditor to generate a PDF slideshow.

examples.title: Disable Page Transition Animation on PDF Page 6

examples.title: Rotate First PDF Page with Proper Disposal
examples.description: The example loads a PDF, rotates the first page 90 degrees clockwise, saves the result to a new file, and uses a using block to dispose the Document and release file handles.

examples.title: Add Text Annotation and Save PDF to MemoryStream
examples.description: Shows how to load a PDF, add a text annotation to the first page, and save the modified document into a MemoryStream for further in‑memory processing.

examples.title: Rotate PDF Page In-Memory Using PdfPageEditor
examples.description: Demonstrates how to edit a PDF completely in memory by loading it from a MemoryStream, rotating a page with PdfPageEditor, and saving the result to another MemoryStream.

examples.title: Delete First Page and Rotate Second Page in PDF
examples.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, deleting the first page, rotating the second page 90° clockwise, and saving the edited document to a new file using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Create Backup and Add Text Stamp to PDF
examples.description: Demonstrates how to copy a PDF for backup, load the original with Aspose.Pdf, add a text stamp to the first page, and save the edited version as a new file.

examples.title: Extract and Rotate Selected PDF Pages
examples.description: Demonstrates how to extract specific pages from a PDF, rotate each extracted page, and save the result as a new PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Get PDF Page Size with Error Handling
examples.description: Demonstrates using Aspose.Pdf's PdfPageEditor to retrieve the size of specific PDF pages and safely handle requests for non‑existent pages using try‑catch blocks.

examples.title: Rotate PDF Page with Validation and Error Handling
examples.description: Demonstrates how to rotate a specific PDF page using Aspose.Pdf while validating the page number and rotation angle, and handling possible runtime exceptions.

examples.title: Resize PDF Pages Using Hybrid Percentage and Absolute Margins
examples.description: Demonstrates how to create a ContentsResizeParameters instance with mixed percentage and absolute margins and apply it to resize the contents of PDF pages using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

examples.title: Incremental Update PDF with Annotation
examples.description: Demonstrates copying a PDF, opening it via a read/write stream, adding a text annotation to the first page, and saving using incremental update mode to preserve the original file structure.

examples.title: Audit PDF Page Modifications (Rotation & Size)
examples.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, logging original page rotation and size, applying a 90‑degree rotation and resizing a page to A4, then saving the document while writing an audit log.

examples.title: Merge PDFs with Uniform Page Size and Margins
examples.description: Loads two PDFs, resizes each page to a common A4 size, applies consistent margins, and concatenates the adjusted PDFs into a single document using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Generate PDF Page Property Report and Apply Size, Rotation, and Zoom Edits
examples.description: The example reads each page of a PDF, records its size, rotation, and zoom, then enlarges the page, rotates it, and applies a zoom factor, finally writing a detailed report and saving the edited document.

examples.title: Reset Page Rotation in PDF
examples.description: Shows how to reset the rotation of page 6 in a PDF document to its default (0°) orientation using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Resize and Rotate PDF Page by 90 Degrees
examples.description: Shows how to shrink a PDF page, adjust its content margins to preserve layout, and then rotate the page 90 degrees clockwise using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Resize PDF Pages to Uniform Size and Split into Chapters
examples.description: Shows how to resize all pages of a PDF to a uniform A4 size using Aspose.Pdf.Document, then split the resized document into separate chapter PDFs with PdfFileEditor.Extract.

examples.title: Resize PDF Pages Containing Text Only

examples.title: Set Page Six to Letter Size Using Aspose.Pdf
examples.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, verify it has at least six pages, and change the size of page six to the Letter format (612 × 792 points) using Aspose.Pdf's SetPageSize method.

examples.title: Resize Specific PDF Pages Using PdfPageEditor
examples.description: Loads a PDF, selects pages 2 and 4, scales their content with a zoom factor using PdfPageEditor, and saves the modified document.

examples.title: Resize PDF Content with Uniform 15% Margins
examples.description: Demonstrates using Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileEditor to resize PDF page contents by applying a uniform 15% margin on all sides.

examples.title: Resize PDF Contents with Custom Top and Bottom Margins
examples.description: Demonstrates how to add different top and bottom margins to a PDF by using PdfFileEditor.ContentsResizeParameters and the ResizeContents method.

examples.title: Resize PDF Pages with Uniform Margins
examples.description: Shows how to uniformly scale the content of all PDF pages so that a fixed margin is kept on every side, using Aspose.Pdf.Document for size information and PdfPageEditor for scaling.

examples.title: Shrink PDF Page Content by 5% Using PdfPageEditor
examples.description: Demonstrates how to uniformly shrink the contents of every page in a PDF by applying a 5 % zoom using Aspose.Pdf's PdfPageEditor.

examples.title: Resize PDF Page Contents with 10% Margin
examples.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileEditor.ResizeContents to add a uniform 10% margin around the contents of every page in a PDF document.

examples.title: Resize PDF Pages While Preserving Annotations
examples.description: Demonstrates how to change the width and height of every page in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf while keeping all existing annotations, form fields, and links intact.

examples.title: Modify PDF Page Size from Byte Array
examples.description: Loads a PDF from a byte array, updates each page's width, height, and orientation via the PageInfo object, and saves the modified document to a new file.

examples.title: Resize Specific PDF Pages to US Letter Size
examples.description: Shows how to change the page size of selected pages in a PDF to US Letter dimensions using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Get Page Rotation Angle Using PdfPageEditor
examples.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with PdfPageEditor and retrieve the rotation angle of a specific page (page 4) using the GetPageRotation method.

examples.title: Retrieve Effective Page Size After Rotation
examples.description: Demonstrates how to rotate a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf, save the document, and then obtain the effective page dimensions that reflect the new orientation.

examples.title: Get Size of a PDF Page Using Aspose.Pdf
examples.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with PdfPageEditor, retrieve the dimensions of a specific page using GetPageSize, and log the width and height.

examples.title: Retrieve and Verify Page Rotation After Resizing PDF
examples.description: The example loads a PDF, reads the rotation of the first page, changes the page size, saves the document, and then confirms that the rotation value remains unchanged.

examples.title: Revert PDF Page Size to Original Dimensions
examples.description: Demonstrates how to store the original width and height of a PDF page, change its size, and then revert it back before saving the document.

examples.title: Rotate PDF Page and Reset Orientation
examples.description: Shows how to rotate a specific page of a PDF by 90° clockwise and then restore it to its original orientation using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Rotate and Resize PDF Page to Letter Size
examples.description: Demonstrates how to rotate the third page of a PDF by 90 degrees and change its size to Letter dimensions using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Rotate Every Third PDF Page to Landscape
examples.description: Loads a PDF, rotates each third page by 270 degrees to achieve landscape orientation, and saves the modified document using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: In-Memory PDF Page Editing with Aspose.Pdf
examples.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF from a MemoryStream, performing basic page manipulations such as deleting and adding pages, and saving the result using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Rotate First Page of PDF Using PdfPageEditor
examples.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with PdfPageEditor, selecting the first page, rotating it 90 degrees, and saving the edited document.

examples.title: Rotate PDF Pages Based on Custom Metadata

examples.title: Rotate Second Page of PDF by 90 Degrees
examples.description: Shows how to load a PDF, verify a second page exists, rotate that page 90° clockwise, and save the modified document.

examples.title: Modify Encrypted PDF: Delete, Rotate, and Append Blank Page
examples.description: Shows how to open an encrypted PDF by providing a password, delete the first page, rotate the new first page, and add a blank page at the end using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Rotate PDF Page 180 Degrees While Preserving Transition

examples.title: Rotate PDF Page Within a Stream

examples.title: Rotate PDF Pages While Preserving Form Fields

examples.title: Rotate PDF Pages to Landscape for Brochure Printing

examples.description: Demonstrates rotating a specific page of a PDF file by setting the Rotation property of Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor to an allowed angle (0, 90, 180, or 270) and saving the modified document.

examples.title: Rotate Page Four by 180 Degrees Using PdfPageEditor
examples.description: Demonstrates how to rotate the fourth page of a PDF document by 180 degrees using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor.

examples.title: Rotate Specific PDF Pages by 180 Degrees
examples.description: Shows how to rotate selected pages (3, 5, and 7) of a PDF document by 180° using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Apply BoxOut Transition to PDF Page
examples.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor to set a BoxOut page transition with a three‑second duration on a specific page of a PDF document.

examples.title: Set Cover Transition on PDF Page

examples.title: Set PDF Pages to A4 Landscape Size
examples.description: Shows how to change each page of a PDF to A4 landscape dimensions by setting PageInfo.Width, Height, and IsLandscape using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Set Custom Page Size for PDF Pages
examples.description: Shows how to change the width and height of all pages in a PDF to non‑standard dimensions using Aspose.Pdf's PageInfo properties.

examples.title: Set Display Duration for Even Pages in PDF
examples.description: Shows how to assign a custom display duration (slide interval) to even‑numbered pages of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor.

examples.title: Set Page Display Duration in PDF

examples.title: Render PDF Page 4 as TIFF with Zoom
examples.description: Shows how to convert a single PDF page (page 4) to a TIFF image while applying a zoom effect by increasing the rendering resolution using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfConverter.

examples.title: Set Page Horizontal Alignment Using PdfPageEditor
examples.description: Shows how to load a PDF, bind it to PdfPageEditor, set the horizontal alignment (left, center, or right) for selected pages, and save the modified document.

examples.title: Set Last PDF Page to A5 Size

examples.title: Set Page Transition Duration Based on Word Count

examples.title: Set Page Transition Duration for a Range of PDF Pages

examples.title: Set Page Transitions (Fade, BoxOut, Cover) in PDF
examples.description: Demonstrates applying different page transition effects (Fade, BoxOut, Cover) to individual PDF pages using Aspose.Pdf's PdfPageEditor.

examples.title: Set Default Zoom for All PDF Pages

examples.title: Set PDF Page Size to Letter Portrait
examples.description: Shows how to resize each page of a PDF to the standard Letter dimensions (8.5" x 11") in portrait orientation using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.description: Loads a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, renders each page to PNG at two zoom levels (0.5 preview using 72 DPI and 1.0 final using 144 DPI), and saves the images to separate directories.

examples.title: Set Per-Page Display Duration in PDF
examples.description: Shows how to assign a different display duration to each PDF page using Aspose.Pdf's PdfPageEditor, increasing the duration by one second for each subsequent page.

examples.title: Apply Different Page Transitions Sequentially in a PDF
examples.description: Shows how to assign various transition effects to individual PDF pages using Aspose.Pdf's PdfPageEditor facade and save the modified document.

examples.title: Set Slide Duration for PDF Presentation
examples.description: Demonstrates how to assign per‑page display durations and a fade transition to a PDF, turning it into a presentation using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Set Split Transition on PDF Page

examples.title: Set Page Zoom to 75% Using PdfPageEditor
examples.description: Demonstrates how to change the zoom factor of a specific PDF page (page 5) to 75% using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor and save the modified document.

examples.description: Demonstrates how to set a zoom factor of 0.8 on all even‑numbered pages of a PDF using PdfPageEditor, then render each page to PNG images with PngDevice.

examples.title: Apply Zoom to Odd Pages in PDF
examples.description: Shows how to set a 1.2 zoom factor on all odd‑numbered pages of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor.

examples.title: Set Zoom on Specific PDF Page
examples.description: Shows how to apply a 2.0 (200 %) zoom to page 7 of a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor.

examples.title: Scale Even PDF Pages by 1.2 Zoom
examples.description: Shows how to apply a 1.2× zoom factor to all even-numbered pages of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfPageEditor.

examples.title: Zoom PDF Pages Containing Images
examples.description: Demonstrates how to detect pages that contain image objects in a PDF and apply a zoom factor only to those pages using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Batch Encrypt PDF Files with User and Owner Passwords

examples.title: Decrypt PDF Using Owner Password

examples.title: Decrypt PDF Using Owner Password from Azure Key Vault
examples.description: Demonstrates retrieving an owner password from Azure Key Vault and using Aspose.Pdf to open, decrypt, and save an encrypted PDF document.

examples.title: Directory Watcher PDF Encryption Service
examples.description: Shows how to monitor a folder for new PDF files, encrypt each PDF with user and owner passwords using Aspose.Pdf, and move the encrypted files to a secure archive.

examples.title: Disable Copying While Enabling Printing for PDF
examples.description: Demonstrates how to protect a PDF with Aspose.Pdf by allowing printing but disabling content copying using encryption and permission settings.

examples.description: Demonstrates applying AES‑256 encryption to a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, decrypting it, and comparing SHA‑256 hashes to confirm that the original and decrypted files are identical.

examples.title: Encrypt PDF with 256‑bit AES and Passwords
examples.description: Shows how to load a PDF, apply 256‑bit AES encryption with user and owner passwords and set permissions, then save the protected document.

examples.title: Encrypt PDF with AES‑256 and Custom Permissions
examples.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, apply AES‑256 encryption with user and owner passwords, set specific permissions, and save the encrypted document using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Encrypt PDF with AES‑256 and Upload to Azure Blob Storage
examples.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt a PDF using AES‑256 with Aspose.Pdf, save the encrypted file, and upload it to an Azure Blob Storage container.

examples.title: Encrypt PDF from Byte Array

examples.title: Encrypt PDF with RC4‑40 using Aspose.Pdf
examples.description: Shows how to load a PDF, apply RC4‑40 encryption with user and owner passwords, set permissions, and save the encrypted document.

examples.title: Encrypt PDF Stream with RC4‑40 using Aspose.Pdf
examples.description: Shows how to load a PDF from a stream, apply RC4‑40 encryption with user and owner passwords, and return the encrypted PDF as a new memory stream.

examples.title: Encrypt PDF and Load into MemoryStream for Network Transmission

examples.title: Encrypt PDF with AES‑256 and Permissions using Aspose.Pdf
examples.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, applying AES‑256 encryption with user/owner passwords, setting specific permissions, and saving the encrypted document while handling exceptions.

examples.title: Encrypt PDF with User Password Only
examples.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt a PDF using only a user password while leaving the owner password undefined, and sets basic permissions before saving the file.

examples.title: Encrypt PDFs and Log Encryption Time
examples.description: Shows how to load multiple PDF files, encrypt each with user and owner passwords, and measure the encryption duration using a Stopwatch for performance monitoring.

examples.title: Load PDF and Verify Page Count
examples.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF file with Aspose.Pdf and confirming successful loading by reading the document's page count.

examples.title: Test Decryption Fails with Incorrect Owner Password

examples.title: Generate PDF Encryption Summary CSV
examples.description: Scans PDFs in a folder, uses Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo to detect encryption, and writes a CSV file listing each file’s encryption status, algorithm placeholder, and permissions.

examples.title: Remove Extended Usage Rights from Signed PDF

examples.title: Allow Form Filling While Disabling Document Assembly

examples.title: Allow Printing Only and Disallow Copying in PDF
examples.description: Demonstrates how to encrypt a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, granting only printing permission while preventing content copying, and then saves the protected document.

examples.title: Update Owner Password of a Protected PDF
examples.description: Demonstrates how to change the owner password of an encrypted PDF while keeping the user password and existing permissions unchanged, using AES‑256 encryption.

examples.title: Update PDF Owner Password While Preserving User Password
examples.description: Demonstrates how to batch‑process PDF files, keeping each document's existing user password while applying a new owner password using Aspose.Pdf encryption APIs.

examples.title: Validate PDF Encryption and Decrypt with Aspose.Pdf
examples.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf's Facades API to determine if a PDF is encrypted before attempting decryption, and then decrypts the document with a password when needed.

examples.title: Digitally Sign First Page of PDF with Visible Signature

examples.title: Add Multiple Digital Signatures to a PDF Page

examples.title: Extract Signing Certificate from PDF Signature Field

examples.title: Remove All Signatures from a PDF

examples.description: Shows how to load a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, convert it to XML with XmlSaveOptions, and gracefully handle malformed XML, PDF conversion errors, and other exceptions.

examples.title: Generate PDF from XML with Graceful Error Handling
examples.description: Shows how to load and parse an XML file with detailed error handling, then create a simple PDF using Aspose.Pdf while handling possible PDF generation errors.

examples.title: Insert Automatic Page Numbers into PDF via XSLT
examples.description: Demonstrates how to convert a PDF to XML, apply an XSLT transformation that adds page numbers, and convert the modified XML back to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Insert Conditional Page Breaks in PDF Based on XML Length
examples.description: Demonstrates loading an XML file, iterating over paragraph elements, and inserting page breaks in a PDF when the accumulated text length exceeds a defined threshold using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Insert Dynamic Page Headers from XML into PDF
examples.description: Shows how to read per‑page header text from an XML file and add it as a TextFragment to each PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Insert Footnotes into PDF from XML
examples.description: Loads footnote definitions from an XML file and adds them as small text fragments to the specified pages of a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Merge Multiple XML‑to‑PDF Documents into a Single PDF
examples.description: The example loads several XML files, converts each to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's XmlLoadOptions, appends their pages to a target Document, and saves the combined result as a merged PDF.

examples.title: Retry PDF Save with Exponential Back‑off
examples.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, adding a text fragment, and saving the document using retry logic with exponential back‑off to handle transient I/O errors.

examples.title: Populate PDF Form Fields from XML Records
examples.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF template, reading XML records, matching XML element names to PDF form field names, setting values for various field types, and saving a filled PDF for each record.

examples.title: Render XML with CDATA Sections to PDF
examples.description: Shows how to load an XML file, recursively traverse its nodes, and write the XML structure—including CDATA sections with distinct background styling—to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: DI-Registered PDF Generation Service with Aspose.Pdf
examples.description: Shows how to register a PDF generation service in the .NET dependency injection container and use it to create a PDF, add text, encrypt, save, and decrypt the document with Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Render HTML CDATA Fragments to PDF
examples.description: Loads an XML file, extracts HTML fragments stored in CDATA sections, renders each fragment to PDF pages with Aspose.Pdf, and combines them into a single PDF document.

examples.title: Render SVG Elements from XML as Vector Graphics in PDF
examples.description: Loads an XML file containing <svg> elements, converts each SVG to a PDF page preserving vector graphics, and merges them into a single PDF document.

examples.title: Repeat Table Header Rows on Each PDF Page
examples.description: Demonstrates how to create a table with a repeating header row that appears on every page when the table spans multiple PDF pages using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Set Custom Page Margins from XML per Section
examples.description: Demonstrates loading margin definitions from an XML file and applying them to specific page ranges in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Set PDF Page Transition Durations from XML
examples.description: Loads timing values from an XML file and applies page transition types and durations to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, employing reflection to access the PdfPageEditor class without a direct Facades reference.

examples.title: Create PDF Pages with Orientation from XML
examples.description: Loads an XML layout, reads the orientation attribute for each <Page> element, and generates a PDF where each page is sized as portrait or landscape accordingly.

examples.title: Set PDF Page Size from XML
examples.description: Shows how to read page width and height values from an XML file and apply them to a PDF page using Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Set PDF Page Size from XML Processing Instructions
examples.description: The example reads processing instructions from an XML file and uses them to define the size of pages added to an Aspose.Pdf document, supporting predefined sizes and custom dimensions.

examples.title: Restrict Printing and Copying in PDF Generated from XML
examples.description: The example loads an XML file, converts it to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, and applies security settings that disable printing and content copying by setting permissions to none and encrypting the document with AES‑256.

examples.title: Set PDF Viewer Preferences When Converting XML to PDF
examples.description: Demonstrates converting an XML file to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and configuring viewer preferences such as FitWindow and PageLayout, employing dynamic typing to stay compatible with older library versions.

examples.title: Sign PDF Created from XML with a Certificate
examples.description: The example converts an XML file to a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, then adds a visible signature field and digitally signs the PDF with a PKCS#7 certificate.

examples.title: Split PDF into Chapter Files Using Bookmarks
examples.description: Loads a PDF, reads its top‑level bookmarks (assumed to be chapters), and creates separate PDF files for each chapter by extracting the corresponding page ranges.

examples.title: Split Large XML‑Generated PDF into Paginated Parts
examples.description: Loads a large XML dataset as a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, then divides the resulting document into multiple PDF files each limited to a set number of pages, saving them with sequentially numbered filenames.

examples.title: Transform XML with XSLT to PDF using Aspose.Pdf
examples.description: Demonstrates loading an XSLT stylesheet, transforming an XML document to HTML (or XSL‑FO), and converting the result to a PDF with Aspose.Pdf. No explicit namespace manager is required because the XSLT declares its namespaces.

examples.title: Validate XML Against XSD Before PDF Generation
examples.description: Demonstrates how to validate an XML file against an XSD schema using XmlReaderSettings and, upon successful validation, generate a PDF document with Aspose.Pdf.

examples.title: Unit Test for XML to PDF Conversion with XSLT
examples.description: Shows how to write NUnit tests that bind XML and XSLT to an Aspose.Pdf Document, generate a PDF, and verify the output file.
